title: Zesty Middle Eastern Eggplant Baba Ganoush
description: A garlicky and flaky Middle Eastern dish featuring roasted eggplant, cider, and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: eggplant
ingredients.notes: preferably black beauty or similar variety

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Poke the eggplants with a fork a few times and roast them in the oven for 45 minutes.
Remove the eggplants from the oven and let them cool down.
Peel the eggplants and place them in a blender or food processor.
Add the garlic, cider vinegar, ferment-kimchi, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the blender.
Blend the mixture until it's smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the baba ganoush to a serving bowl and garnish with parsley or paprika.
